# Coached by Resume Worded - your no-BS, weekly career coach

Hi, future reader! It's Rohan.

In short - I'm obsessed with figuring out what makes careers tick.
A few years ago, I realized most career advice was either too fluffy or totally BS and disconnected from reality.
I decided to fix that - so I started Resume Worded and this email series, Coached.

Here's what to expect from every email:

- Practical career strategies you won't get anywhere else.
- Email templates you can copy-and-send to easily grow your network.
- Step-by-step frameworks proven to get promoted and grow as a leader.
- Everything from email tricks to make you sound like a CEO, how to never get nervous, and body language hacks that will help in high pressure career situations.

No fluff, no-BS — just practical stuff that will give you a leg up in your career.

Whether you're a mid-level manager or gunning for the C-suite, there's something here to help you level up.

My promise to you is that every single email will add value to your career. And I mean it. If an email doesn't pass our high quality bar, I won't send it out — even if I've spent days on it. This email is not about quantity. It's about quality career ideas that will make a noticeable impact if you implement them in your day-to-day.

See you in your inbox,

## Rohan

Founder at Coached & Resume Worded

Connect with me on LinkedIn
